A balanced recorder then gives compact-support Navier-Stokes forcing periodic after loading and a fixed open-cube halting detector. Further clock and observer variants have separate bounds and comparison classes.

records.score_rationale: Whole-box inverses, overlapping transport, and all-time detector control impose substantial geometric and effective-construction dependencies.
records.archive_note: The mailing-transport candidate concerns optimal-plan graph structure, not incompressible box transport or machine coding.

records.title: Uniform Interior C^{1,\alpha} Estimates for Infinity-Harmonic Functions
records.description_paragraph: This paper claims uniform interior differentiability with a positive Hölder gradient exponent for bounded infinity-harmonic functions in every dimension at least three. The exponent depends only on dimension, lies at most one-third, and is not explicit. Gradient size and seminorm are controlled by oscillation on a larger ball. Neither endpoint exponent nor boundary regularity is claimed; the assertion concerns Euclidean interior estimates rather than constructing a general Riemannian theory.
records.scoring_target_statement: The stated bounded infinity-harmonic functions satisfy dimension-uniform interior first-derivative Hölder estimates for some positive dimensional exponent.
records.score_rationale: Uniform higher-dimensional gradient regularity requires delicate degenerate nonlinear PDE estimates.
records.archive_note: The candidate asks existence of a theory for general Riemannian metrics, not this Euclidean interior regularity theorem.
records.progress_rationale: Conditional on mathematical acceptance, the manuscript claims a full answer to the explicitly scored target. This does not establish competition eligibility, novelty, or accepted credit for a broader related archive problem.
